Bench: Pankaj Bhatia

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Ram Gopal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Rama Kant Dixit,Ram Vishal Tripathi,Siddhartha Dixit
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ram Vishal Tripathi
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0397 of 2022, under Section 498A, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Motipur, District Bahraich.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant around five years ago and sufficient dowry was also given.
Subsequently, she was found dead on 19.07.2022.
The postmortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature mark, no other injury was found.
PW 1 and PW 2 have turned hostile during trial.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Ram Gopal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Ram Gopal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 5. Considering the aforesaid facts, the applicant who is in custody since 21.07.2022 and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ram Gopal be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.3.2024 nishant  Ram Gopal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118093825/
